verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Canny exposing its data to external LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) through an MCP server, where those tools produce themes and insights. That analysis happens in third-party AI tools, not inside Canny. Autopilot automatically captures feature requests from transcripts and conversations, but nothing documents it generating insights or suggestions for users inside the product, so it is an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
